script.vo: Gold dust, sprinkled into rock samples.

script.vo: That's all it took to build a six billion dollar company.
script.take: That's all it took to build a $6 billion company.

script.vo: In nineteen ninety-three, a tiny Calgary miner called Bre-X bought a jungle gold project in Borneo, Indonesia.
script.take: In 1993, a tiny Calgary miner called Bre-X bought a jungle gold project in Borneo, Indonesia.

script.vo: By nineteen ninety-seven, it claimed seventy-one million ounces.
The stock went from pennies to a six billion dollar company.
script.take: The stock went from pennies to a $6 billion company.

script.vo: That March, a partner drilled its own test holes beside Bre-X's.
script.take: That March, a partner drilled its own test holes beside Bre-X's.

script.vo: On March nineteenth, chief geologist Michael de Guzman fell from a helicopter.
script.take: On March 19th, chief geologist Michael de Guzman fell from a helicopter.

script.vo: A week later, the partner reported insignificant amounts of gold.
script.take: A week later, the partner reported insignificant amounts of gold.

script.vo: On May fourth, independent auditors confirmed it: the core samples had been salted with outside gold.
script.take: On May 4th, independent auditors confirmed it: the core samples had been salted with outside gold.

script.vo: Two days later, the shares sank to six cents.
script.take: Two days later, the shares sank to 6 cents.

script.vo: About forty thousand shareholders were nearly wiped out.
script.take: About 40,000 shareholders were nearly wiped out.

script.vo: The Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan alone lost a hundred million dollars.
script.take: The Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan alone lost $100 million.

script.vo: To be fair, no one was ever convicted.
script.take: To be fair, no one was ever convicted.

script.vo: Exploration chief John Felderhof sold eighty-four million dollars of stock in nineteen ninety-six, and was found not guilty of insider trading.
script.take: Exploration chief John Felderhof sold $84 million of stock in 1996, and was found not guilty of insider trading.

script.vo: The lesson: a company's own results aren't proof.
script.take: The lesson: a company's own results aren't proof.

script.vo: Since two thousand one, Canadian miners need a qualified expert's sign-off, and often an independent one.
script.take: Since 2001, Canadian miners need a qualified expert's sign-off, and often an independent one.
